Global Dating & Matchmaking App – Development Requirements

Platforms: iOS and Android
Project Type: Global Dating & Matchmaking Application

1. Project Overview

* Develop a modern, secure, scalable dating application for iOS and Android.
* Support users worldwide across all countries, states and cities.
* Focus on genuine profiles, face verification, privacy, location-based discovery and secure communication.
* Develop a separate web-based Admin Dashboard.
* Design the architecture to support millions of users in the future.

2. User Registration & Authentication

* Mobile number registration with OTP verification.
* Email registration and verification.
* Google Sign-In.
* Apple Sign-In.
* Mandatory 18+ age restriction.
* Forgot password and account recovery.
* Secure login and logout.
* Account deletion and deactivation.

3. Face Verification & Genuine Profiles

* AI-based face verification.
* Live selfie capture.
* Facial recognition and liveness detection.
* Compare selfie with profile photographs.
* Detect fake photographs and duplicate accounts.
* Manual verification for suspicious cases.
* Display a verified badge on approved profiles.
* Allow users to filter verified profiles only.
* Re-verification when suspicious activity is detected.

4. User Profile Management

Allow users to create and manage profiles with:

* Name and date of birth.
* Gender.
* Sexual orientation.
* Interested-in preferences.
* Country, state and city.
* Multiple profile photographs.
* About Me / Bio.
* Education and profession.
* Languages.
* Hobbies and interests.
* Profile verification status.
* Profile visibility and privacy settings.

Gender options:

* Male
* Female
* Non-binary
* Other / Self-described
* Prefer not to disclose

Sexual orientation options:

* Straight
* Gay
* Lesbian
* Bisexual
* Pansexual
* Asexual
* Other / Self-described
* Prefer not to disclose

The matching system must respect individual preferences and privacy.

5. Global Location-Based Discovery

* Support all countries, states/provinces and cities.
* Automatically detect current location with user permission.
* Find nearby profiles based on geographical distance.
* Allow manual country, state and city selection.
* Allow users to search profiles from any selected location.
* Display approximate distance between users.
* Support worldwide profile discovery.

Radius selection:

* 5 KM
* 10 KM
* 25 KM
* 50 KM
* 100 KM
* 250 KM
* 500 KM
* Unlimited
* Allow users to change the search radius anytime.
* Allow users to disable location visibility.
* Never expose exact residential coordinates.

6. Private Photos & Photo Viewing Requests

Provide two photo visibility options:

* Public Photos: Visible to eligible users.
* Private Photos: Hidden by default.

Photo request functionality:

* Display a Private Photos indicator on profiles.
* Allow users to send photo viewing requests.
* Notify profile owners about incoming requests.
* Allow users to accept or reject requests.
* Display private photographs only after approval.
* Allow owners to revoke photo access anytime.
* Support individual photo permissions.
* Maintain pending, accepted and rejected request history.
* Provide protection against unauthorized downloads and screenshots where technically supported.

7. Likes, Interests & Matching

* Like other profiles.
* Send interest.
* Accept or reject interests.
* Withdraw sent interests.
* View received interests.
* View sent interests.
* Add profiles to favourites/shortlist.
* Receive notifications for new interests.

Matching workflow:

* User A sends interest to User B.
* User B receives a notification.
* User B accepts the interest.
* System creates a mutual match.
* Both users receive match notifications.
* Chat and calling become available according to privacy settings.

8. Chat & Messaging

* Real-time one-to-one chat.
* Text messaging.
* Image sharing.
* Emojis and stickers.
* Voice messages.
* Message delivery status.
* Read receipts.
* Typing indicators.

* Block and report functionality.

9. Voice Calling

* One-to-one voice calls.
* Incoming call notifications.
* Accept/reject calls.
* Mute/unmute microphone.
* Speaker functionality.
* Call history.
* Missed call notifications.

10. Video Calling

* One-to-one HD video calls.
* Front/rear camera switching.
* Camera and microphone controls.
* Incoming video call notifications.

full_description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist with expertise in both On-Page SEO and Off-Page SEO/Link Building to improve the keyword rankings, Domain Authority (DA), organic traffic, and Google search visibility of our Germany-based industrial valve manufacturing website.

Primary Target Market: Germany
Secondary Markets: Europe and International Markets
Industry: Industrial Valves, Manufacturing, Engineering, Oil & Gas, and Industrial Equipment

We have identified 20 target keywords with corresponding URLs and will provide SEO-optimised articles for off-page submissions.

We require a freelancer who can handle on-page optimization and acquire high-quality backlinks consistently.

1. On-Page SEO Requirements

The freelancer must review and optimize all 20 target landing pages for better Google rankings and organic visibility.

A. Keyword and Page Optimization

Optimize all 20 target keywords and their corresponding landing pages.

Review and improve meta titles and descriptions.

Optimize H1, H2, and H3 headings.

Ensure proper keyword placement within page content.

Improve existing product category descriptions where required.

Include relevant technical terms such as valve types, materials, pressure classes, industry applications, and applicable standards.

Identify relevant secondary and long-tail keywords.

Avoid keyword stuffing and unnecessary repetition.

Resolve keyword cannibalization between similar product categories.

B. Content Optimization

Review existing page content for technical accuracy, uniqueness, and SEO relevance.

Improve thin or insufficient category descriptions.

Optimize content for industrial buyers, engineering contractors, procurement companies, and distributors.

Include relevant valve specifications, materials, applications, and operating characteristics.

Improve content readability without removing important technical information.

Ensure pages clearly represent our German manufacturing positioning and European market focus.

Avoid duplicate content across similar product categories.

C. Technical SEO

Review website indexing and crawlability.

Identify and fix broken links, redirect errors, and duplicate meta information.

Check canonical URLs and XML sitemap configuration.

Review [login to view URL] and indexing directives.

Improve page loading speed and Core Web Vitals where technically feasible.

Check mobile usability and website structure.

Review structured data/schema markup where applicable.

Identify technical issues affecting organic search performance.

D. Internal Linking

Improve internal links between relevant product categories and product pages.

Link related valve types, materials, and industrial applications naturally.

Ensure important landing pages are accessible to search engines.

Improve website navigation and internal link relevance.

E. Germany and European SEO

Prioritize rankings and search visibility in Germany.

Optimize relevant keywords for German and European search intent.

Identify opportunities for German-language keyword variations.

Recommend German-language content where it would improve organic visibility.

Review international SEO and hreflang implementation where applicable.

Ensure geographical references are consistent with our actual business location and target markets.

The freelancer must provide recommendations and implement approved on-page changes where website access is provided. Major content or structural changes require approval before implementation.

2. Off-Page SEO and Backlink Requirements

We require a minimum of 2 backlinks per keyword per week.

Total target keywords: 20

Minimum backlinks per keyword: 2 per week

Minimum weekly backlinks: 40

Minimum monthly backlinks: 160 (4-week period)

Backlinks must point to the corresponding product category or relevant landing page.

The objective is to build consistent, high-quality backlinks that support better Google rankings, domain authority, organic traffic, and online visibility.

Backlinks must be distributed across all 20 keywords rather than concentrated on a few categories.

3. Backlink Distribution

50% – High DA Websites (80 Backlinks Monthly)

DA 50 or above.

General business websites, established blogs, publications, and reputable content platforms.

Genuine organic traffic and indexed content.

Contextual links within relevant content are preferred.

Avoid artificially inflated DA/DR metrics.

International websites are acceptable where relevant.

30% – German and European Websites (48 Backlinks Monthly)

Germany must be the main priority.

Prefer German websites and relevant .de domains.

Other acceptable domains include .at, .ch, .eu, .fr, .it, .nl, .es, and other European domains.

German-language business publications and relevant blogs are preferred.

European business websites, directories, and online publications are acceptable.

Websites must be active, indexed, and have genuine traffic.

Audience relevance is more important than domain extension alone.

20% – Industry-Specific Websites (32 Backlinks Monthly)

Relevant websites covering:

Industrial valves and flow control.

Mechanical engineering and manufacturing.

Oil and gas and petrochemicals.

Power generation and energy.

Chemical processing and automation.

Water and wastewater treatment.

Industrial equipment and machinery.

Construction and infrastructure.

Engineering and B2B publications.

Industry-specific opportunities may be limited; therefore, we allow a combination of high-authority general websites, European platforms, and engineering-related websites.

Each backlink must be classified under one category for reporting purposes.

4. Paid Posting Guidelines

Paid guest posting and paid backlink placements should be avoided wherever possible.

Priority should be given to legitimate free editorial opportunities, guest contributions, relevant business listings, and suitable industry platforms.

Any proposed paid placement must receive approval in advance. Third-party placement fees must not be included without prior approval, and approved paid links must comply with applicable search engine guidelines.

5. Strictly Avoid

Private Blog Networks (PBNs) and link farms.

Automated or bulk backlink-building tools.

Spammy or low-quality websites.

Irrelevant business directories.

Gambling, casino, betting, adult, and unrelated websites.

Websites primarily created for selling backlinks.

Artificial Web 2.0 networks.

Forum profile links and comment spam.

Duplicate or spun articles.

AI-generated spam and poor-quality submissions.

Websites with fake organic traffic or inflated DA/DR.

Deindexed or blocked pages.

Hidden links, redirects, and sitewide footer links.

Excessive exact-match keyword anchor text.

Repeated low-value links from the same domain.

Unapproved changes to website structure, product specifications, or existing technical information.

Quality is more important than simply meeting the quantity target.

6. Content and Link Placement

We will provide:

20 target keywords.

Corresponding target URLs.

SEO-optimised articles for backlink submissions.

The freelancer will be responsible for identifying appropriate publishing platforms, outreach, article submissions, and obtaining live backlinks.

Anchor text must be natural and varied, including branded, partial-match, and contextual phrases.

German-language article placements are preferred on appropriate German websites.

7. Monthly Reporting Requirements

A detailed Excel or Google Sheets report must be submitted monthly.

On-Page SEO Report

Target keyword and corresponding page URL.

Existing and updated meta titles and descriptions.

Content optimization completed.

Heading improvements.

Internal links added or modified.

Technical SEO issues identified and resolved.

Indexing status.

Keyword ranking changes in Germany.

Organic clicks, impressions, and CTR where available.

Remaining recommendations and pending work.

Off-Page SEO Report

Published backlink URL.

Referring domain.

DA / DR.

Website country and domain extension.

Estimated monthly organic traffic.

Target keyword and linked URL.

Anchor text.

Dofollow / Nofollow / Sponsored status.

Backlink category.

Publication date and indexing status.

Total backlinks per keyword.

All reported backlinks must be live, publicly accessible, and independently verifiable.

Duplicate URLs, broken backlinks, and non-existent placements will not count toward the monthly target.
